address: Callejón de la Estacada 9, A Coruña, 15001, Spain
bio: Located along a narrow street in the city’s old quarter, yet just a few steps from the boats moored at the Real Club Náutico de A Coruña, NaDo boasts a thoroughly modern look, with an open-view kitchen and just two long tables that can be adjusted according to the number of guests. Here, chef Iván Domínguez, who is constantly moving between the kitchen and the dining room, creates contemporary cuisine with its roots in Galicia and the Atlantic. This is showcased in particular on the Furancho surprise menu, on which the chefs themselves select the dishes to be served....
